environment.description: Ktor microservice deployed on EKS with standard IAM role. The signing service downstream accepts keyRef from config-service responses and performs signing operations using the referenced key. Network policies allow config-service to communicate with signing-service. No input validation middleware. Service mesh (Istio) in permissive mode with no AuthorizationPolicy enforcement on internal traffic.

config.network: Flat pod network, no NetworkPolicy resources applied
config.signing_service: Accepts keyRef parameter from config-service without re-validation
config.hsm_access: signing-service IAM role has pkcs11-provider access to all HSM key slots
